description: Meta — Facebook/Instagram ads performance by day (campaign, ad set, ad), Facebook Page insights and posts, Instagram account insights and media

meta_campaign_daily.description: Ad spend, delivery and headline actions per campaign per day

meta_adset_daily.description: The same per ad set per day

meta_ad_daily.description: The same per ad per day

meta_actions_daily.description: Every action type (count, value, cost) per object per day

meta_page_daily.description: Facebook Page metrics per day (long: metric, value)

meta_page_posts.description: Facebook Page posts with lifetime insights in meta_post_insights

meta_ig_daily.description: Instagram account metrics per day (long: metric, value)

meta_ig_media.description: Instagram posts and reels with lifetime insights in meta_ig_media_insights

spend_and_leads_by_campaign.description: Spend, leads and calls per campaign, last 30 days
spend_and_leads_by_campaign.sql: SELECT campaign_name, SUM(spend) AS spend, SUM(leads) AS leads, SUM(calls_placed) AS calls FROM meta_campaign_daily WHERE date >= date('now','-30 days') GROUP BY campaign_name ORDER BY spend DESC

rejected_metrics.description: Organic metrics Meta refused (deprecated or unavailable)
rejected_metrics.sql: SELECT * FROM meta_metric_errors ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC

api_integration.method: Meta Graph API + Marketing API (version pinned in client.js)
api_integration.rate_limits: Business use case + app usage, reported in response headers; the client paces above 75%
